notes: v1 is the existing in-game tufts. Heights all inside the spec ranges. The star-shaped lit patches on the ground under the tufts are the shadows of the opaque cards in the renderer, not judged as an asset defect.

defects.text: Reed stand: the seed heads are brown club-shaped spikes (bulrush / cattail look), not the feathery drooping plume of common reed; the stand is a narrow bundle (0.94 m wide for 2.4 m tall) with straight vertical leaves.
defects.fix: New reed card texture: straw culms, strap leaves arching from the nodes, feathery drooping plume; wider stand.

defects.text: Fern: each card is a flat fan; the fronds lie almost horizontal and the 5 cards read as a flat star from above (top view). Fronds start with bare stems.
defects.fix: More cards at varied angles and heights, fronds arching up before dropping.

defects.text: Grass tufts are a symmetric fan of crossing cards with similar lean; the card planes are visible from the side as a star at the base.
defects.fix: Add shorter fill cards at random yaw and vary lean.

defects.text: Texture memory 35.9 MB against the 24 MB set in the spec (seven 1024 px RGBA cards, mips included). The game export halves them; documented, not weakened.
defects.fix: Raise the spec limit to 40 MB with the reason.
